scope: QtQuick6 production gallery: attached tooltip role on one real TableView delegate and four real scrollbars.

environment.runtime: Qt 6.8.2, PyQt 6.9.0, KDE org.kde.desktop QML controls, xcb

implementation.change: Scrollbar hoverChanged events prepare the attached tooltip's dynamic KDE Tooltip role before the native 750 ms display delay; the popup visibleChanged hook remains for when it opens. No timer scan or static final color was added.

verification.result: 5/5 live hover targets reported the active KDE Tooltip colorSet and matching background/text roles.
verification.menu_regression: The probe continued to its independent menu-row sample and then failed to show that menu hint. The menu code was not changed here; R141 covers its prior pass. This run is not a complete gallery pass.
verification.full_hover_matrix: R149 attempt timed out after 90 seconds while the isolated bus logged host inotify exhaustion and portal startup delays; no result is counted.
verification.existing_warning: KDE TabButton.qml still emits the prior null-y warning at startup; not attributed to this patch.

next: Retain R54/R141 evidence for delay/menu behavior, continue T07 on another authorized uncovered scope, and revisit the full QtQuick matrix only when a new discriminating test can run within the available private session.
